paite: Huan Mosi in Israel suan Intekpente ahoupih a, "TOUPA'N thu apiak pentak hiai ahi.
heading: Kichiamna Toh Kisai Dante
english: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which Yahweh has commanded.

paite: Mi'n TOUPA kiang a thu achiam a ahihkeileh athuchiam a kihenleh athuchiam abohse ding ahi kei. Akam a pawt bangbang ahih ding ahi.
english: When a man vows a vow to Yahweh, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

paite: "Numei in leng anungak lai a, apa inn a a-om lai a, TOUPA kiang a thu achiam a, athuchiam a akihen a;
english: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to Yahweh and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

paite: athuchiam leh athuchiam a akihenna apa'n azak a, apa'n adaihsan maimahleh athuchiam tengteng apaisuak ding ahi. Athuchiam a akihenna a-om gige ding ahi.
english: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

paite: Himahleh apa'n azak ni a aphal keileh athuchiam a akihenna thuchiamte akoi mahmah apaisuak kei ding. Apa'n aphal louh ziak in TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding hi.
english: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. Yahweh will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

paite: "Thuchiam min thu khual lou a, ahenna a-om lai a pasal aneih a;
english: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

paite: apasal in azak a, azak ni a, adaih dideleh athuchiam a-om gige dia, thuchiam a ahenna leng a-om gige ding.
english: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

paite: Himahleh apasal in azak ni a aphal keileh atung a thuchiam leh khual lou a akihenna amang dia, TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding.
english: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. Yahweh will forgive her.

paite: "Himahleh meithai hiam, mak a omnu hiam thuchiam zaw, ahenna tengteng in adelh gige ding.
english: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

paite: "Inn a thu achiam a, kichiam a akihenleh,
english: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

paite: apasal in azak a leng adaih dide a, aphal louh keileh athuchiam a-om gige dia, kichiam a akihenna leng a-om gige ding hi.
english: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

paite: Himahleh apasal in azak ni a bangmah lou a bawl a, ahihmangleh athuchiam hiam, kichiam a akihenna a kam a thupawt peuhmah a-om nawn kei ding. Apasal in ahihmang khinta ahi. TOUPA'N amah angaidam ding.
english: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. Yahweh will forgive her.

paite: Thuchiam tengteng leh hinna hihgim dia hen akichiamna tengteng apasal in akipsak thei in ahihmang thei hi.
english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

paite: Himahleh apasal in azak ni a pan adeihdan leh athuchiam tengteng leh atung ahenna om tengteng kipsak ahi a; azak ni a pan adaihsan ziak in akipsak ahi.
english: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.

paite: Himahleh azak khit nung a bangmah lou a bawl a, ahihmanleh athulimlouhna moh apuak ding ahi," achi hi.
english: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

paite: Hiaite pasal leh azi kal leh apa inn a a-om gige lai a, akikal ua dan ding a TOUPA'N Mosi thu apiakte ahi uh.
english: These are the statutes which Yahweh commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.
